name: Enter Application After Passkey Registration
summary: The newly registered user continues from enrollment confirmation into the application home view using the authenticated session already issued by the registration ceremony.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == authenticated-normal and home-workspace == established and current-workspace == home

postconditions.expression: session-capability == authenticated-normal and app.home is visible

sourceReferences.note: The final continue action is client navigation because the authenticated session already exists.
